label: Order
caption: HIGHLAND CAPITAL MANAGEMENT, L.P. V. NEXPOINT ADVISORS, L.P., ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, case No. 23-10534, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Thursday, June 5th, 2025, by 12 p.m. (EDT).
